headline_marked: Brazil's Vinicius [[apologises to fans for World Cup exit]]
headline: Brazil's Vinicius apologises to fans for World Cup exit
summary: The Real Madrid star expressed 'enormous frustration' after Brazil's shock 2-1 Round of 16 defeat to Norway.
details: Real Madrid superstar Vinicius Junior has apologised to Brazilian fans following the national team's elimination from the World Cup.
The five-time world champions suffered a shock 2-1 defeat against Norway in the Round of 16, leading to their early exit from the tournament.
In an Instagram message, the 25-year-old forward expressed 'enormous frustration,' stating that he knows how much he prepared and focused for the fans and his family.
Vinicius admitted that the squad was strong enough to achieve more, but failed to do so, promising to 'fight' to return the Selecao to the top of the world.
Despite the team's exit, Vinicius had a strong individual performance in the tournament, scoring four goals and providing one assist.
National teams coordinator Rodrigo Caetano has reaffirmed his confidence in Italian coach Carlo Ancelotti despite the disappointment of the World Cup result.
caption:
Brazil's World Cup dream ends in shock. Vinicius Junior breaks his silence on the 'enormous frustration' of their exit.

Real Madrid superstar Vinicius Junior has apologised to Brazilian fans following the national team's elimination from the World Cup.

The five-time world champions suffered a shock 2-1 defeat against Norway in the Round of 16, leading to their early exit from the tournament.

In an Instagram message, the 25-year-old forward expressed 'enormous frustration,' stating that he knows how much he prepared and focused for the fans and his family.

Vinicius admitted that the squad was strong enough to achieve more, but failed to do so, promising to 'fight' to return the Selecao to the top of the world.

Despite the team's exit, Vinicius had a strong individual performance in the tournament, scoring four goals and providing one assist.

National teams coordinator Rodrigo Caetano has reaffirmed his confidence in Italian coach Carlo Ancelotti despite the disappointment of the World Cup result.

Source: Somoy News, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline_marked: Tensions rise as [[Iran claims it kept its word]] on US ceasefire
headline: Tensions rise as Iran claims it kept its word on US ceasefire
summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Tehran adhered to the truce, while Donald Trump insists the ceasefire is over.
details: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated on Saturday that Tehran has "kept its word" regarding a ceasefire with the United States.
This comes after Donald Trump insisted that the truce was over, though he indicated a willingness to engage in further negotiations with the Islamic republic.
Araghchi claimed on X that the US Treasury Secretary has violated Paragraph 9 of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), which pertains to the deployment of additional forces in the region.
Meanwhile, shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz has decreased for the third consecutive night amid threats of 'total war' from Iran.
Qatari mediators have reportedly arrived in Tehran to help navigate the escalating tensions between the two nations.
caption:
Iran says it adhered to the ceasefire, but the US claims it's over. Now, shipping in the Strait of Hormuz is dropping.

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated on Saturday that Tehran has "kept its word" regarding a ceasefire with the United States.

This comes after Donald Trump insisted that the truce was over, though he indicated a willingness to engage in further negotiations with the Islamic republic.

Araghchi claimed on X that the US Treasury Secretary has violated Paragraph 9 of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), which pertains to the deployment of additional forces in the region.

Meanwhile, shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz has decreased for the third consecutive night amid threats of 'total war' from Iran.

Qatari mediators have reportedly arrived in Tehran to help navigate the escalating tensions between the two nations.
